# Golden State Rehab

> Joint Commission accredited and DHCS-licensed (#191643AP) outpatient addiction and mental-health treatment center in Westwood, West Los Angeles. Programs: PHP, IOP, telehealth, individual & group therapy, medication management. Evidence-based modalities including CBT and DBT. Works with most major PPO plans. Bilingual care — se habla español. Admissions available 24/7 at (424) 208-3120.

- [Home](https://www.goldenstate-rehab.com/): Los Angeles outpatient addiction & mental-health treatment center

## About
- [Why Choose Us](https://www.goldenstate-rehab.com/about): six verbatim five-star Google reviews, Joint Commission listing #750952, DHCS license #191643AP, clinician license lookups
- [Our History](https://www.goldenstate-rehab.com/our-story): opened May 26, 2026; Joint Commission accredited August 12, 2026; the team's earlier careers and a dated 2026 timeline
- [Meet the Team](https://www.goldenstate-rehab.com/team): all eight staff with photos and roles; Medical Director Dr. Eric Chaghouri, MD (board-certified psychiatrist)
- [Locations & Areas We Serve](https://www.goldenstate-rehab.com/locations): Westwood office; serving West LA, Santa Monica, Beverly Hills, Culver City
